coverage_override.reason: The Ritual Spell activation procedure and separate GY-triggered immediate Pendulum Summon are the two effects; alternate Ritual locations and material requirements are conditions of the activation procedure.

effects.printed_clause: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any Cyberse Ritual Monster from your hand, OR, if you control "Bitron", "Protron", and/or "Digitron", you can also Ritual Summon it from your face-up Extra Deck or GY. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation selects any Cyberse Ritual in hand, expanding to GY and face-up Extra Deck while a face-up controlled named Normal Monster exists; it selects hand/field Ritual Materials totaling at least the Level, handles freed/Extra Deck zones, releases materials, Ritual Summons, and completes the procedure. External Glitchling Corruption counters are included only through that card's separately established material substitution.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Ritual Spell can Ritual Summon from hand or GY and tributes hand/field materials totaling at least the Ritual Monster's Level.
Official effect-based Ritual Summon uses subgroup Level totals, material assignment/release, SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL, and CompleteProcedure.

effects.printed_clause: If your opponent Special Summons a monster from the Extra Deck, while this card is in your GY, and "Glitchling Witch" or "Glitchling Mage" are in your Pendulum Zone: You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Pendulum Summon a Cyberse monster. You can only use this effect of "Glitchling Data-Transfert" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed opponent Extra-Deck-Summon trigger with id HOPT and GY banish cost requires either named Pendulum monster face-up in a Pendulum Zone, constructs temporary extra-Pendulum-Summon permission, computes the scales/zones and legal Cyberse hand/face-up-Extra candidates, then uses Omega-style Pendulum subgroup validation with minimum and maximum both set to one before raising the Pendulum event and Special Summoning that single selected monster with SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM.

official_references.matched_structure: Official immediate Pendulum Summon computes scales/zones, validates a selected Pendulum group, raises EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS_G_P, and uses SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM. Data-Transfert now retains this pattern while bounding its subgroup to exactly one.
Official extra Pendulum Summon permission uses EFFECT_EXTRA_PENDULUM_SUMMON and the same Pendulum-procedure event handling.

effects.issue: Fixed the over-broad selection: penop previously allowed 1 through every available zone via math.min(#tg,ft); it now calls SelectSubGroup with bounds 1,1, so the printed singular Cyberse monster is enforced without bypassing Omega's Pendulum legality checks.
